items.title: Rob Mounsey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 9, 2025
items.q: Paul and Roy Halee asked me. I was in the studio with them

ctx.x: How did that happen? You were listening to the track and it just like, you’re humming to yourself? I mean can you describe that?

Paul and Roy Halee asked me. I was in the studio with them and they asked me, “Can you make a brass section play this figure that the rhythm guitar is playing.” It was of the African rhythm guitarists. I’m sorry I don’t remember his name.
